changelog: New voice command "read last line" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ লাইন পড়ে শোনাও" in Bengali) and only the last line before the cursor is read aloud, so you can check a long message one line at a time instead of hearing the whole thing from the start. It is the scoped twin of v15.4's "read last sentence" and v15.5's "read last paragraph". The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 57 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
